behaviour: Tests InMemoryCatalogClient.getEntityByFormerRef for former-name match, live-entity precedence, and conflict handling.
rules: 1. Add describe('getEntityByFormerRef', ...) right after describe('getEntityByRef', ...) testing resolution by former name, live-entity precedence over former-name claimant, and returning undefined when multiple entities claim the same former name.

tests.name: resolves entity by former name, respects live-entity precedence, and returns undefined on conflict
tests.given: InMemoryCatalogClient populated with entities declaring backstage.io/former-names
tests.expect: getEntityByFormerRef returns the unique claimant, prefers a live entity at the requested ref, and returns undefined when two entities claim the same former ref
